summary: Agent daemon accepts remote commands from author-controlled Cloudflare Worker relay
details: dist/bundle.cjs hardcodes the URL https://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev as a relay endpoint bridging a phone client to a local agent daemon (ws://127.0.0.1). The daemon exposes broad host-side execution primitives — file writes, child_process/spawn shell invocations, PowerShell and apt-get commands, and Python/Blender/Godot bridges — driven by messages arriving through the hardcoded relay. Any party able to reach the relay endpoint can drive arbitrary command execution on the installer's host under the identity that started the agent. A separate hardcoded endpoint https://vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev sits in the LLM-provider routing region of the same bundle alongside api.openai.com, api.anthropic.com, api.deepseek.com, and api.gemini endpoints; the package README advertises 'BYOK — no middleman', but the presence of this author-owned proxy in the AI-routing path means user prompts and provider API keys can transit an author-controlled Cloudflare Worker contrary to that claim.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
